bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Upsala Area Historical Society.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; UPSALA AREA HISTORICAL SOCIETY. +]

[+$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Upsala Area Historical Society for a museum to preserve historical artifacts and the rich immigrant history of the Upsala area. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Upsala Area Historical Society.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; UPSALA AREA HISTORICAL SOCIETY.

$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Upsala Area Historical Society for a museum to preserve historical artifacts and the rich immigrant history of the Upsala area.
additions: $300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Upsala Area Historical Society for a museum to preserve historical artifacts and the rich immigrant history of the Upsala area.
